# CommonMark 0.31.2 test data

This directory contains the upstream CommonMark specification test corpus in `commonmark-0.31.2.json`.

- Title: CommonMark Spec 0.31.2
- Author: John MacFarlane
- Source: https://spec.commonmark.org/0.31.2/
- License: Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0 International (CC BY-SA 4.0), https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/
- Changes: the corpus is stored unmodified; W.mdx tests select cases and compare parser semantics.
